responsibilities: Responsible for developing and maintaining the existing data platform in the cloud
Perform analysis of proposed information requests and collaborate with the business units to drive enterprise reporting
Write scripts for importing and exporting data into enterprise applications, maintaining the integrity of the data across the applications
Use enterprise report writing tools to extract data and share information for automated reporting in compliance with regulatory guidelines
Always strive to meet corporate goals and look for opportunities to use technology to do so
Select the best technology solutions for business problems
Ensure pristine data quality in all delivered solutions
Provide solid documentation on all design and coding projects
Maintain confidentiality of the information being processed, stored, or accessed by the end-users on the network
Ensure that the data architecture is scalable and maintainable
Design, implement, and continuously expand data acquisition by performing extraction, transformation, and loading activities
Build, debug, monitor and troubleshoot databases and ETL processes to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and integrity
Design, develop and maintain data stores (data warehouses, data marts and related information repositories) to support organisational reporting, analytics, and integrations
Translate business needs to technical specifications for BI
Design, implement, monitor, and maintain BI environments and database servers to meet usage and performance demands
Establish performance and reliability metrics for all data stores, reports, dashboards, and analytics tools
Design, implement and tune relational queries, stored procedures, and table-valued functions for optimal performance and reliability
Create and maintain supporting documentation, including data dictionaries, data flows and database schemas, necessary to document database environments and ensure maintainability
Collaborate with developers, product owners and business analysts in conceptualising, designing, and developing new database applications, modules, and enhancements
Assist with the design and development of data schemas and definitions to support Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing requirements
Follow and maintain data security policies and practices

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure pristine data quality in all delivered solutions
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Correctness dominates the accountabilities - pristine data quality, integrity, reliability metrics, documentation, security policies - against a single 'Manages tight deadlines' line in the requirements.
evidence.domain_risk: Use enterprise report writing tools to extract data and share information for automated reporting in compliance with regulatory guidelines
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A corporate intelligence and due diligence platform where reporting must comply with regulatory guidelines and the role requires knowledge of GDPR and CCPA plus confidentiality obligations.
evidence.collaboration_width: developers; product owners; business analysts; offshore teams
evidence.data_team_maturity: This opportunity is to work with their Data & BI Team, scoping out new potential developments and redevelopments of their data platform used by their clients.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A named Data & BI Team with an existing cloud data platform to develop and maintain, but no sub-teams, scale figures or governance tooling at scale are described.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, implement and tune relational queries, stored procedures, and table-valued functions for optimal performance and reliability
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The accountabilities go down to stored procedures, table-valued functions, data dictionaries and ETL package configuration - detail no recruiter template contains.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Design, develop and maintain data stores (data warehouses, data marts and related information repositories) to support organisational reporting, analytics, and integrations
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The outputs are warehouses, BI environments and data dictionaries serving organisational reporting and other developers, with no specific business function named as the audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Select the best technology solutions for business problems
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Technology selection and establishing reliability metrics sit alongside scoped delivery work like 'Perform analysis of proposed information requests' and 'Assist with the design and development of data schemas'.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI and machine learning are never mentioned in the posting, so no AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Build, debug, monitor and troubleshoot databases and ETL processes to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and integrity
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality and reliability are owned accountabilities - 'Ensure pristine data quality in all delivered solutions' and establishing reliability metrics - rather than tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Maintain confidentiality of the information being processed, stored, or accessed by the end-users on the network
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Regulatory compliance, confidentiality, data protection law and security policies recur as accountabilities in their own right - the fear is regulatory and confidentiality exposure, not just broken pipelines.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Responsible for developing and maintaining the existing data platform in the cloud
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The brief is explicitly 'new potential developments and redevelopments', pairing new build with maintaining the existing platform and migrating legacy systems to cloud architectures.
evidence.work_arrangement: Based Oxford 3 days per week, 2 days remote
evidence.loss_aversion: Use enterprise report writing tools to extract data and share information for automated reporting in compliance with regulatory guidelines - the risk being controlled is non-compliant reporting and breaches of confidentiality in a due-diligence business. Note: this is a recruitment agency posting; the client is described only as a 'fast growing, international organisation', and the stated GBP 60-65,000 basic salary carries no period wording so salary_period is left null.
